archetype_description: Electric & Neon meets Jewel & Luxury. A premium, deep space dark theme with vibrant cyan and electric blue accents, layered with high-end glassmorphism and soft glows.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white

surfaces.glass_card: bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] relative overflow-hidden
surfaces.button_primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 text-white font-medium rounded-full px-8 py-3 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(34,211,238,0.6)] transition-all duration-300
surfaces.button_secondary: bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.1] text-white font-medium rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-white/[0.08] transition-all duration-300 backdrop-blur-md

navbar.instructions: Sticky at top with backdrop blur. Must contain Logo (Name), links to sections, and a small CTA. Smooth scroll to sections using standard anchor links or framer-motion scroll.

hero.layout: min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden
hero.instructions: Use hero_particles_bg as absolute background image behind a very dark overlay (bg-[#040814]/80) to create deep texture. Large animated headline with gradient text for 'Thanoj', subtext, and two buttons. Include the profile photo in a glowing glassmorphism orb/circle.

about.instructions: A large bio card alongside a grouped skill pills card. Skill pills should be styled as glowing tags (border-cyan-500/30 bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-300).

projects.instructions: 3-4 glassmorphism cards. Each has an image header, title, description, tech stack badges, and a Github/Demo link. Add a subtle cyan glowing orb behind the cards in the background.

experience_timeline.instructions: A vertical timeline down the center or left edge. Each node has a glowing cyan dot. Content animates in from the side on scroll.

education.instructions: Clean, minimal glass card with degree details.

contact.instructions: Use Shadcn Form components. Dark inputs (bg-black/50 border-white/10). Links to socials.

images.description: Abstract 3D particles glowing cyan and electric blue on a deep navy void background. Use this behind the hero section with an overlay.
Professional portrait to be used in the Hero or About section.
Abstract geometric glassmorphism shapes floating in dark space. Use this as an ambient background behind the projects section with low opacity (10-20%) and mix-blend-screen.

testing_attributes.instructions: All interactive elements, forms, and key headers MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-primary').
